findings.why_not_priced: Computable but not pre-announced, and with one covering analyst and a retail-heavy register nobody has published the Q3 NAV bridge; if it were priced the stock's slide would track EUR/SEK, but since 30 Sep EUR/SEK has fallen back to 11.21 while the stock kept falling, so the slide is about liquidity/D-shares, not this line. Partly priced, hence small. EUR/SEK series: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EURSEK=X?range=1y&interval=1d

findings.finding: SBB's consolidated core holding Sveafastigheter booked a positive merger accounting effect of SEK 3,065m in Q3, the item SBB postponed its report to analyse; SBB's Q3 headline profit is therefore likely to contain a large one-off merger effect, probably positive at the headline though roughly NAV-neutral and of uncertain size at group level.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance; Sveafastigheter itself rose +6.8% on its 18 Nov report, a day that also carried a new dividend policy, so the gain's own effect is not separable
findings.why_not_priced: The SBB-level accounting is unknown to everyone, which is why the report was delayed three weeks; SBB B fell 1.7% on 18 Nov and kept drifting, so the market has not marked up SBB for Svea's headline gain. A one-off with no path to cash, sized at a fraction.

'Understatement' / size the move on what is new, not on history: abs_move raised from 6.5 to 7.0 (the period's numbers are new; the observed report-day median ~6.2% is a floor)
